methodology.generator: autocannon rate ceiling, closed loop; not an independent open-loop arrival generator
methodology.memory: server process RSS, heap and external bytes sampled every second; no process-tree sum
methodology.upstream: simulated local HTTP dependency, fixed delay, no database or real external API
methodology.validation: native validators for the measured valid body and one missing-name rejection; not full semantic equivalence
methodology.cpu: cumulative process CPU microseconds in raw samples; approximate phase deltas
limitations: generator and simulated dependency share the host
RSS is not live JS heap
short runs cannot establish absence of leaks
no Flow or Raspberry Pi measurement
client response bodies checked before and after, not during timed load
